quote: Hadamard's determinant theorem and the sum of four squares, Duke Mathematical Journal, Vol. 11, No. 1, pp. 65-81 (1944)
note: This is a sub-case of the Hadamard conjecture with its own distinct origin. Williamson posed this in 1944 as a means to construct Hadamard matrices of order 4n using four circulant matrices satisfying a specific algebraic condition.
